IGUI_KnoxScanner_about: Writes the events ticked below to Zomboid/Lua/KnoxScanner.txt. A small command outside the game posts them to Discord or any other tool.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_note_tip: A short note above your character each time an event is written.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_bitten_tip: Your character gets a new zombie bite.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_landmark_tip: You walk into a police station, gun store, prison, hospital and the like.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_storm_tip: A thunderstorm, tropical storm or blizzard starts.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_horde_tip: Forty or more zombies within twenty tiles.
IGUI_KnoxScanner_request_tip: The key below writes a request event.
